digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC multi-project integration test rehearsal
propositions: A fake Jira transport masks real failure modes like non-existent project keys that parse-error in real Jira; live validation against ephemeral DC is required to catch cross-project contamination and genuine JQL semantics.

Non-existent project keys cause the inbound fetcher to abort the entire pass because per-project queries lack per-project exception handling; real Jira rejects unknown keys with parse-error rather than returning empty.

The rehearsal must provision isolated throwaway projects per run to model three repo shapes (one/two/zero repos), an empty project, and an unknown-project fail-closed path; two shared production Cloud projects are insufficient.
Dry-run gating via preview assertion ensures every mutating scenario write targets only its intended project with empty intersection against other configured projects before sync runs.

Scratch projects are created with a hardened pinned template and verified for required issue types/fields before any scenario runs; they are deleted on every exit path including mid-run failures via session-scoped finalizers.
A configured project key never created in the DC instance must cause a bridge pass to fail closed (per-project search raises, pass writes nothing) rather than proceeding or silently degrading.
